thread:
Sophie L.: Quick heads-up 14dd I opened a PR to normalize autoscale policy examples across the dedicated capacity docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278
Marco V.: Nice. Can you include both YAML and Python examples? A compact Python sync + async example would be great.
Sophie L.: Added YAML + Python sync. Left async as an extra in a short footnote. Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.capacity.create(
  tenant_id='acme',
  reserved_pool='bronze-reserved',
  autoscale={'min_instances':1, 'max_instances':10, 'target_rps':150},
  labels={'env':'prod'}
)
```
Irene C.: Please add one explicit sentence: "isolation_preference is advisory; scheduler may override under capacity pressure." Many customers are confused.
Sophie L.: Done. Also clarified "labels" vs "tenant metadata" in a short FAQ entry.
Marco V.: SLA/legal wants a precise copyable sentence about preemptible pools being excluded from the standard latency SLA. Can you add a suggested snippet?
Sophie L.: Added suggested SLA sentence: "Allocations on preemptible pools are not covered by Redwood's standard latency SLA; use reserved pools for SLA-backed latency guarantees."
eng-platform: Quick technical note: recommend including the 15m quiet window when promoting to reserved pools and a recommended mirror % (start with 5%). Also add a short point about applying a scale policy to the reserved pool to avoid starvation.
Sophie L.: Incorporated the 15m quiet window + 5% mirror recommendation and the scale-policy tip. Added Terraform one-liner to show min_instances for pools.
Irene C.: Can we add a tiny troubleshooting bullet list for common provisioning failures: quota, tag mismatch, KMS perms, missing pool label?
Sophie L.: Done. Also added a short rollback checklist: 1) stop promotion; 2) route traffic back; 3) shrink pool; 4) open oncall if evictions spike.
Marco V.: Small doc nit: the link to eviction behavior pointed to an outdated path. Use /docs/operational/eviction-behavior.
Sophie L.: Fixed links. Left a comment asking eng-runtime to confirm wording about quantized-model cold-starts on older GPUs.
eng-platform: Confirmed: quantized models can add ~200-400ms on first-token cold-starts for some hardware; noted in parenthetical. Also recommend clients implement simple retry/backoff for stream reconnects.
Sophie L.: Added a minimal JS streaming reconnect example and the quantization parenthetical. JS snippet:
```js
// resume after brief backoff
stream.on('error', async () => {
  await sleep(300);
  client.stream.start({resumeFrom: lastOffset});
});
```
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278 (Sophie L.)  reviewers requested: @Marco V., @Irene C.
Marco V.: LGTM from docs side. Irene, any objections before we ping legal & eng-runtime for final signoff?
Irene C.: No objections. Please tag legal for the SLA sentence and eng-runtime for the quantization note.
Sophie L.: Thanks all 44d scheduling a 10-min SIG-docs review tomorrow to merge after signoffs.
